description: ElectionGuard v2.1.0 hash-chain KAT vectors, generated by test/kat/eg_kat.py from the specification only (not from the C# implementation).

conventions.hex: uppercase, big-endian; Z_p values are 512 bytes, Z_q / 256-bit values 32 bytes
conventions.H_q: H mod q; such vectors carry expected_hmac_hex (raw) and expected_hex (reduced, 32 bytes)
conventions.strings_files: b(len, 4) || bytes, len = UTF-8 byte length

inputs.derivation: K_{i,j} = g^a_{i,j}, K_hat_{i,j} = g^ahat_{i,j}, kappa_i = g^zeta_i mod p; a_{i,j} = 100i + 10j + 1, ahat_{i,j} = 100i + 10j + 5, zeta_i = 1000 + i; j=0 overridden to a = (10, 20, q-25), ahat = (30, 40, q-63) so that K = g^5 and K_hat = g^7 (main_chain); K = prod_i K_{i,0}, K_hat = prod_i K_hat_{i,0} mod p (eqs. 25, 26)

vectors.notes: B0 = H_B (p.27 image and §5.5.2 table). B1 is guardian-major: all K_{i,j} (i outer, j inner), then all K_hat_{i,j} in the same order, then kappa_1..kappa_n. len(B1) = 1 + (2 + 2nk + n) * 512 per the §5.5.2 table. b1_layout gives [offset, length, label] for every field.

vectors.equation: (88) d_i = H(H_E; 0x30, ind_c(Lambda), ind_o(lambda), i, A, B, a_i, b_i, M_i, U)
vectors.name: d_1 ind_c=1 ind_o=1 U=[1, 3]

inputs.derivation: main_chain election (n=3, k=2, K=g^5, s=5); z_i = P(i) from the n=3,k=2 guardian_record_hash polynomials; (A, B) = product of the three ballots' (ind_c, ind_o) ciphertexts; M_i = A^z_i (84); a_i = g^u_i, b_i = A^u_i (87); u_1=1001007, u_3=1003007

vectors.notes: B0 = H_E (eq. 88 and §5.5.4 table, p.77). U is encoded b(#U, 4) || b(j_1, 4) || ... || b(j_#U, 4); the spec does not state the order of the j's, this oracle uses ascending order. len(B1) = 2577 + 4*#U per the table. b1_layout gives [offset, length, label].

vectors.equation: (90) c = H_q(H_E; 0x31, ind_c(Lambda), ind_o(lambda), A, B, a, b, M) [= Verification 10.B]
vectors.name: c ind_c=1 ind_o=1 U=[1, 3] t=2

inputs.derivation: a = prod a_i, b = prod b_i (89); M = prod M_i^w_i (86) = A^5; w_i per (85); T = B * M^-1 (82) = K^t; c_i = c*w_i (91); v_i = u_i - c_i*z_i (92); v = sum v_i (93). The script asserts Verification 10.1-10.3 recompute exactly M, a, b from (c, v, t), 10.A-10.C hold, and Note 3.7 (94)/(95) hold per guardian.

vectors.notes: B0 = H_E (eq. 90, Verification 10.B and §5.5.4 table, p.77); len(B1) = 2569. No public key and no U in B1. Verification 10 uses no other hash. b1_layout gives [offset, length, label].
